what-must-survive-removing-policy-pins.text: What must survive removing policy pins.
As an integrator, I want to see each existing guarantee, the proposed replacement and the evidence still needed before trusting a registry without pins.

This inventory binds the accepted source revision in authority.md. Every candidate claim below is a hypothesis. Accepted declarations, statements, wire formats, application rules and guarantees remain unchanged; hypothetical additions are recorded below. Old definition digests are SHA256 of the complete source-file blob; theorem digests are the base register's statementSha256. A declaration existing or a digest matching proves identity only.

The eleven configuration fields are listed individually. The constitution's driver translation still calls config an "eight-field" value, although the bound structure has eleven fields. This discrepancy is recorded in questions.md; its text is not amended here. The proposed four-field datum does not authorize dropping registration cost or booking width.

unavailable-ledger-boundaries.text: The ledger vocabulary ticket remains open; its draft is unaccepted. The history ticket remains open with no matching pull request found. Required vocabulary is unavailable at the base: script-purpose invocation, applied script identity, full ledger values, accepted history, one-shot genesis and spent-at-most-once. These are dependency roles, not invented declaration names, and are excluded from declaration checking.

One transaction may invoke two state policies using one spent seed. Across-history spent-once forbids spending it again later; it does not by itself exclude this same-transaction case. Name-only registry binding remains unresolved. No competing ledger layer is introduced.

reader-meanings-and-asset-roles.text: The observation contract requires active application custody, pending termination, never registered, terminal and unavailable evidence. Existing held and leaf observations support logical census and leaf classification; world supply additionally counts genuine pending tokens. None supplies provider freshness/completeness or proves application/release identity from an empty lookup. A negative token lookup alone cannot select the other four classes.

State, active witness, trie-ready request tag and application tag occupy distinct abstract records or fields today. The positive trie-ready name distinguishes it from abstract state name zero; it proves no witness/request-tag separation under the proposed shared concrete policy. A genuine witness at the state address carrying a fabricated state datum still requires an authenticated full-identity/state-provenance proof. Wrong kind/key/registry, extra mint/burn and unrelated application assets remain explicit adverse cases for the later candidate.

consumers-and-compatibility.text: Implementation consumers are inventoried only: genesis, registry validators, configuration and identities, applied script parameters, asset names, transaction builders, and CLI creation, resolution and folding. They are neither edited nor evaluated by this slice.

Model consumers remain byte-identical: root driver/naming/lifecycle/permanent corpora and theorem registers; application corpus and theorem ledger; simulator mirror; coverage record; public model/theorem explanation and economics paper/register. No regeneration is due from documentation-only inventory; every future semantic change reopens its mapped consumers. No implementation evidence row changes.

The permanent translation keeps the two-edge law, fixed admission, applicable exits, datum delivery and public inputs. Its exact compatibility text is: "Registries from previous releases, including old Demo1 instances, are abandoned: no migration or compatibility recognition is authorized." The epic's exact architectural text is: "Existing registries retain their contracts and explicit compatible-release paths. New application policies create new state policies for new registries." The named releases and scope are unresolved; neither sentence is silently superseded here.

identity-premises-and-next-decision.text: Research records each proposition, its domain and a satisfying instance, separating executed premises over the existing model from written candidate examples. Questions gives the concrete starting state, competing outcomes, evidence limits and ruling needed. Unresolved means the proposed replacement is not accepted, including when the old theorem is registered as proved.

statement-audit-result.text: An independent statement audit on 22 October 2026 found the candidate ready to prove: twelve stated obligations and the true inversion of the rejected name-only reading, with two expected-refutable claims ready for constructive refutation. Nine of nine public cases have one derived inversion, twenty-nine mutants own all twenty-three guards, and fifteen negative controls failed for their intended reasons. The audited statement identities are statements.json 97450a8880920e1f81b97a02e2e449c76aec7baa9ae2b17fab63f7fc93fccb87 and lean/NoPin/Statements.lean 586c5ee86be8a691970ba245472e4d7be67303667242e42f53a905e6f2d838de in investigations/741-no-pin/. This establishes neither the truth of any statement nor hash separation for a real hash, provenance validity, ledger behaviour, or any custody, economic or reader claim. Separation among witness, trie-ready and application assets, and wrong-key and wrong-registry refusal for the authenticated reading, are not yet stated; they are required before any role-authentication claim.

candidate-boundary-at-the-interface-chec.text: Candidate boundary at the interface checkpoint.

The isolated NoPin project freezes interfaces in functions-model.md and records in data-model.md. Complete registry identity follows the recorded ruling; name-only binding remains a rejected contrast. State-recognition alternatives stay hypothetical. Custody, economic configuration, reader classification and compatibility remain outside this stage.

The minimal TxView.spent must map to accepted ledger spending-input references; outputs.assets to complete output values; mint to signed per-policy/name quantities; invoked to actual policy invocation. A list of views must bind to accepted history and its spent-once theorem before any history claim becomes a ledger guarantee. These are binding obligations on #679/#680, whose vocabulary remains unavailable here. This view has no validity judgement, script evaluator or UTxO update. Its genesis predicate and explicit spent-once premise do not implement those missing layers.

identity-statements-candidate.text: The candidate states fifteen obligations; every body remains sorry and the statement ledger records sorryAx debt with standard axioms. Public inversion cases and atomic guards are discovered from the compiled candidate. Separate antecedent instances, candidate instances and single-guard falsifications execute without proof holes. These are author receipts for bounded statement review, not acceptance, general proofs, hosted CI or ledger execution.

Complete-identity approval refusal explicitly covers distinct policies with the same seed-derived name. A single observed transaction can satisfy both application-specific genesis predicates while spending the seed once. The history predicate separately refuses repeated spending in a supplied list of observations. Accepted-history correspondence remains held until the upstream model is bound.

The rejected name-only safety claim and hypothetical policy-only exclusion claim have separate expected-refutable markers. Concrete evaluations expose both unsafe readings. Authenticated state/role separation is stated under explicit finite encoding/hash and seed-name premises; provenance remains external input evidence. Request-tag inversions cover the simplified registry/role/key preimage only, not economic payload/nonce commitments. All preserved economic, custody, consumer and reader rows above retain their prior dispositions; no implementation evidence row changes.
